notes.title: GDC 2017 Schedule
notes.content:

- GDC Prototype/Playtest Night
28th February, 7pm - 10pm

- Game Night with Kickstarter and Game Jolt
2nd March, 8pm - 10pm

- GDC Intel Booth 
3rd March, 10am - 3pm

notes.title: Software Update 0.23 - Released
notes.content:
Thanks for all the early feedback, stay tuned for updates in the next few days. Your input will definitely help make GoatPunks the best it can be.

Updates: 
- beginner, advanced, and king difficulty settings.
- ninja punk skill fixed
- bombs active only at target and not when falling.

notes.title: Winner of Best Game Physics for 2016 Intel Level Up Game Developer Contest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25934254/c637191ee1b33812bb8f995d2dd7df60f01d157e.png[/img]
GoatPunks brings home a win from Intel Level Up Game Developer Contest. 

The winners will be live on Twitch broadcasting from PAX West at the Intel Booth. on September 1st at 4:30pm. 

GoatPunks will be a part of the Intel Booth Living Room Gaming on the Skull Canyon machines on Saturday 9/3 at 2pm - 6pm. I hope to catch you there.
